floater.name: floater_sk_ots_options
floater.title: OVER-THE-SHOULDER MOUSELOOK

check_box.label: Enter mouselook over the shoulder
check_box.name: ots_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Mouselook places the camera behind your shoulder and shows your avatar. Aiming, movement and tools work exactly as in first-person mouselook.

slider.label: Side offset (m):
slider.name: ots_side
slider.tool_tip: Positive puts the camera over the left shoulder, negative over the right

check_box.label: Keep the camera out of walls and floors
check_box.name: ots_collision
check_box.tool_tip: Pull the camera in when world geometry is between you and it. Avatars and phantom objects never block the camera.

check_box.label: Snap aim onto the avatar under the crosshair
check_box.name: ots_avatar_converge
check_box.tool_tip: Your shots, which always leave from your eye, converge on the hitbox of the avatar under the crosshair, not the wall behind them. Uses the same box as Avatar Hitboxes, a stand-in for the real physics shape.

check_box.label: Remember the last view (shoulder or first person)
check_box.name: ots_remember_view
check_box.tool_tip: Enter mouselook in whichever view you last switched to with the Shoulder / First Person key, instead of always over the shoulder.

floater.text: Bind Shoulder / First Person and Swap Shoulder under Preferences > Controls, in the camera rows for first person mode (Mouselook).
